subject: Closure rhythm: signer windows, DocuSign timing, and kickoff slot

Subject: Closure rhythm: signer windows, DocuSign timing, and kickoff slot

Hi Katie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our mutual action plan I attached an updated MAP (MAP_v2.xlsx) that tightens the final paper flow and the proposed start-date window. Two asks so we can get the DocuSign out today:

1) Confirm primary signer + backup (name, title, email) and their typical availability windows (e.g., mornings only / needs 48 hours).
2) Confirm preferred contract start date window — on your side you mentioned "first week of July"; we penciled in July 5-6 to align with onboarding bandwidth.

Plan on our side: Ben will prepare a redline-free SOW and send a DocuSign envelope; Marissa will coordinate onboarding slots and the kickoff agenda. If we have signer details by EOD PDT we can route the envelope today and target countersign by 6/30 (DocuSign) which preserves the July 5 commencement.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP + milestone dates)

Thanks — short note back with the signer info is perfect.

—Stephanie

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Quick answers:

- Primary signer: Grace Alvarez, VP Finance (grace.alvarez@stellarus.com). Grace is usually available afternoons PT but requires finance/legal review; plan on 48–72 hours once she receives the DocuSign.
- Backup signer: Chris Yuen, Head of Ops (cc'd). Chris can escalate for faster review if needed.
- Preferred start date: StellaRus would like July 5 as the official start (so July 6 kickoff for onboarding is fine).

Procurement has a PO template and will want to attach it to the final envelope; I attached the PO template for reference. We also need the SOW to include the SLA bullets we discussed and a short clause on data retention (30 days cache, 365 days audit logs).

If you can send the DocuSign by EOD today we will do our best to get Grace the envelope first thing Monday and aim for a countersign by 6/30.

Thanks,
Katie

Stephanie / Marissa —

Thanks — noted on Grace's 48–72 hour window. Operational plan below:

- I will produce a clean SOW with SLA bullets and the short data retention clause and attach SOW_startdate_proposal_0705.pdf.
- I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope with two routing steps: (1) Grace Alvarez (Finance) — default sign; (2) Chris Yuen (Ops) — backup. We will also include a file attachment placeholder for the customer's PO (they can upload after we send).
- Marissa: can you lock the onboarding kickoff slot for July 6 at 10am PT? If Grace needs more time we can still begin onboarding with a read-only kickoff and ramp permissions after countersign.

Also attaching a small CSV to track signer availability (signature_availability_sheet.csv) — please fill in the expected turnaround to use for SLA/activation planning.

If we get confirmation from Katie today I can queue DocuSign for 15:00 PT.

—Ben

Katie —

Great — thanks for the quick confirmation. We are green to proceed with the following final plan:

- DocuSign envelope will be sent today at 15:00 PT to Grace Alvarez (primary) and then Chris Yuen (backup).
- Envelope contents: Clean SOW (finalized SLA & data-retention clause), MAP_v2, standard Redwood MSA, and a placeholder for your PO.
- Target countersign date: 2027-06-30 (we will monitor and loop if Grace needs additional review time).
- Official contract start date: 2027-07-05; onboarding kickoff arranged for 2027-07-06 10:00 AM PT (Marissa will send calendar invite once envelope is signed).

If you need us to route to anyone else (legal procurement or security) please let us know now — otherwise we will send to Grace and Chris as agreed.

Thanks and excited to get you onboarded.

—Stephanie
